about_the_game:
Game Overview

You unexpectedly wake up in the body of the Supreme Leader of North Korea. While life at the top seems glamorous, danger lurks at every corner. One wrong move can cost you everything.

As the country’s highest authority, you must carefully navigate internal power struggles, manage international tensions, and make critical decisions with long-lasting consequences. From nuclear development to economic policies, from luxury indulgences to political purges — your every action shapes the fate of the nation.

Gameplay Features

  • Handle daily reports and issue directives that influence diplomacy, domestic stability, and your own survival.

  • Balance key elements: nuclear ambitions, economic hardship, public satisfaction, and elite loyalty.

  • React to random events and crises — betrayals, invasions, opportunities — where choices matter.

  • Acquire luxuries like high-end vehicles and yachts, but beware: indulgence might attract envy or suspicion.

  • Maintain control through strategic decisions, manipulation, and calculated risks.

Only those who master the art of power can survive — and thrive — at the top.
